@[simp]
theorem arctan_inv_sqrt_three : arctan (√3)⁻¹ = π / 6 :=
  arctan_eq_of_tan_eq (by simp) <| by constructor <;> linarith [pi_pos]

@[simp]
theorem arctan_eq_pi_div_three : arctan x = π / 3 ↔ x = √3 :=
  arctan_injective.eq_iff' arctan_sqrt_three

@[simp]
theorem arctan_eq_pi_div_six : arctan x = π / 6 ↔ x = (√3)⁻¹ :=
  arctan_injective.eq_iff' arctan_inv_sqrt_three
